notes.title: Checkpoints Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

In today's update I am adding checkpoints to the Adventure Mode! 

What does this mean?

If you enable checkpoints, once you get to a new section, a button will appear at the start of the level allowing you to get back to that section whenever you want. Passing through a section checkpoint will take your fastest time for that section and save it. Once you hit the button you will be spawned to that section and the time will start playing when ready. 

You will also notice a new number displayed in the bottom left of your screen. This is for keeping track of how many moves you have made in your current run. This move count will be used for certain achievements when the main game releases!

Other Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a small bug with the locks on the boards displaying when in the incorrect section. 
[*] Added a prevention for Stockfish bugs where each Stockfish instance was being set with the incorrect board position. 
[/list]

I have also added the following optimizations:

[list]
[*] Faster piece loading
[*] Faster board loading
[*] Decreased number of player loop calls when falling increasing FPS

[/list]

As always, don't forget to join the discord for the latest!

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here are the fixes in today's patch:

[list]
[*] Attempting to move chess pieces from a section that you are not currently standing in will no long result in a Stockfish error.

[*] You can no longer softlock yourself by trying to move pieces in a different section and getting checked.

[*] Standing on a square where Stockfish decides to move it's piece will no longer clip you through multiple pieces. It will instead put you at the closest adjacent empty tile.

[*] Changing controls in the middle of game play now updates the controls immediately instead of having to restart.

[*] Some localization updates have been made to better contextualize the translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update: Improved Tutorial, New Features, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972953/45c19aee02f561b8b617686c169cbb4770788229.png[/img]Hello Everyone!
Firstly, thank you to every one of you who has taken the time to play the demo and provide feedback—it means a great deal to me and has been very helpful! I read every comment and consider the community's input as much as I can.

With that said, let's dive into what’s changing in this update:

[h2][u][b]The Tutorial[/b][/u][/h2]
Based on your feedback, I noticed that the tutorial didn’t explain the movement mechanics well enough, which caused some confusion and frustration. To address this, I’ve added a Movement Tutorial that will pop up before the main tutorial.

This new tutorial is designed to better demonstrate the spacing needed for certain jumps and provide more clarity on how jump failures work. If you’ve already mastered the mechanics, you can skip the movement tutorial, and it can also be revisited from within the main tutorial level for additional practice.

Separating the movement mechanics from the main tutorial has allowed me to add new boards to the main tutorial, giving players a better idea of what to expect from the game.

All high scores achieved on the previous version of the tutorial have been archived and are still viewable in game under the tutorial high scores.

[h2][u][b]Custom Settings[/b][/u][/h2]
Custom settings have been added to Adventure Mode!

[i]What does this mean?[/i]
You can now adjust the following settings in Adventure Mode:

[list]
[*] Stockfish ELO Level: Choose between 500–2500.
[*] Board Type: Select from Casual, Normal, or Immortal. (Each difficulty has unique chess positions, with Casual being the easiest and Immortal the hardest.)
[*] Jump Failure: Toggle this feature On or Off.
[*] Reset Type: Choose between resetting by Each Section or Entire Level.
[/list]
💡 Note: Playing on custom settings disables the ability to set high scores on the Steam Leaderboard.

[h2][u][b]Gameplay Updates[/b][/u][/h2]
[h3]Stockfish ELO Rating Adjustments[/h3]
The base Stockfish ELO rating has been increased as follows:

[i]Adventure Mode:[/i]
[list]
[*] Casual: 800 → 1000
[*] Normal: 1000 → 1300
[*] Immortal: 1300 → 1600
[/list]

[i]Stacks Mode:[/i]
[list]
[*] Base ELO: 1000 → 1300
[/list]

[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Jump Failure Timing by one tick to improve playability.
[*] Boards outside the section you are currently in are now locked. Entering a section with your pawn unlocks the appropriate boards for that area.
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Other Improvements[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the respawn/reset camera functionality for smoother gameplay.
[*] Optimized respawn/reset board loading efficiency and added a loading screen.
[*] Added descriptions to cosmetics to indicate how to unlock them.
[*] Updated Checkmated board color to stand out more.
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where releasing the jump early in the safe area resulted in a lower-than-expected jump.
[*] Checkmated boards in previous sections now reset correctly.
[*] Fixed a glitch where gameplay could continue despite pressing the pause button.
[/list]


Thank you all for your continued support! I’m excited for you to try out these updates, and as always, I look forward to hearing your feedback. For more feedback and updates on the game join the discord here [url=https://discord.com/invite/Y3HN89FaQu]https://discord.com/invite/Y3HN89FaQu[/url]

-- Doug

notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
After some feedback and internal review the bounce factor has been removed completely from the players fall mechanic. 

[b]What does this mean?[/b]

When the character pawn is falling and hits a flat surface it will no longer bounce off at high velocity. Instead, the pawn will have a significant reduction in ricochet value upon landing (0.44 to 0). The landing will also have a 3% friction increase to slow down any slide that may occur. 

It is important to note that the pawn can still bounce off the side of chess board pieces and walls! Also, depending on the speed and angle that the pawn is falling at upon impact with the flat surface the pawn will still continue to fall downward but to a lesser extent than before.
